blurb: Pomodoro timers help build focus by breaking work into structured intervals — but on watchOS, that means managing background execution and battery constraints most apps don't face. Built a native Pomodoro timer for watchOS using Swift, driven by a TimerManager built on WKExtendedRuntimeSession to keep sessions running in the background, with a circular progress ring, local notifications on session completion, and customizable durations via a dedicated SettingsView. Covered the core logic and UI with unit and UI tests written in Swift Testing, targeting TimerManager, PomodoroState, and session labels.
